import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_gui_module import YourGUIClass

class TestYourGUI(unittest.TestCase):

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_patient_pressure')
    def test_gui_display_patient_pressure(self, mock_get_patient_pressure):
        mock_get_patient_pressure.return_value = 120  # SRS value
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        gui.update_patient_pressure()
        self.assertEqual(gui.patient_pressure_display, 120)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_volume_data')
    def test_gui_graph_refresh_rate(self, mock_get_volume_data):
        mock_get_volume_data.return_value = [0] * 100  # SRS value
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        with patch('time.sleep', return_value=None):
            gui.update_volume_graph()
            self.assertEqual(len(gui.volume_graph_data), 100)

    def test_gui_graph_duration(self, mock_get_volume_data):
        mock_get_volume_data.return_value = [0] * 300  # SRS value
        gui = YourGUIClass()
        with patch('time.sleep', return_value=None):
            gui.update_volume_graph()
            self.assertEqual(len(gui.volume_graph_data), 300)
